text:
nina: Quick sync after the PM: we agreed on three follow-ups for the observability gaps uncovered — missing spans surfaced by alerts, bad daily aggregates (we're seeing >10% drift), and periodic ETL stalls during peak. Need owners, concrete checkpoints, and automated recurrence detection.

pedro: I'll take ownership of the "missing spans" ticket. Initial hypothesis: a short-lived sampler change from service-proxy rolled last week. I'll roll a revert candidate and add a canary. Filing ticket RED-5110. Plan: repro script today, revert PR tomorrow, canary Friday.

alyssa: I'll own the daily aggregate drift. Looks like the aggregator job isn't normalizing tag variants anymore after the tag normalization change. I'll add a dedupe+norm step and build a nightly parity job comparing raw counts vs normalized counts. Target: PR Mon, canary Tue.

mike: ETL stalls are probably consumer backpressure combined with a GC bump on the worker fleet. I'll add a jittered backoff to the consumer, bump heap on staging, and wire an SLO check for ETL 95th latency. PR by Wed, deploy Thu.

observability-bot: alert: spans_missing_rate high in prod (service=frontend) — triggered 2027-04-10T22:03:12Z — linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-5110

nina: For recurrence detection, propose two things: 1) anomaly job that compares today's aggregate to 7-day median and opens a ticket when delta > 0.12, 2) a recurrence counter that marks incidents as 'recurring' if same signature appears >2 times in 30d. Who can prototype the SQL?

alyssa: I can prototype the aggregate anomaly query. rough sketch:

```
WITH today AS (
  SELECT metric, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM metrics_raw
  WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  GROUP BY metric
),
median7 AS (
  -- precomputed daily medians table
  SELECT metric, median_count FROM metrics_7day_median
)
SELECT t.metric, t.cnt, m.median_count
FROM today t
JOIN median7 m USING(metric)
WHERE ABS(t.cnt - m.median_count) / NULLIF(m.median_count,0) > 0.12;
```

alyssa: I'll wire it to a daily cron and have it auto-create RED-5112 with the payload. ETA prototype by Fri.

pedro: For signature detection of missing spans, I think signature = service + endpoint + missing_span_ratio_bin. If same signature triggers twice in 30d auto-tag. I'll add a small bloom filter-based cache to avoid reopening duplicate noise.

mike: On the ETL SLO, I'll define a Prom rule: `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(etl_processing_seconds_bucket[15m])) > 2` (seconds) and an alert that pages p1 only if accompanied by consumer_lag > 10k. Otherwise lower urgency.

nina: Nice. Let's publish these owners and deadlines in the postmortem doc (I'll update). Also we should add a short roll-forward plan for each change and a rollback play: what to call, what job to disable, queries to revert.

observability-bot: ticket opened RED-5112 by automation: Aggregate drift detector prototype.

alyssa: small ask: I need a golden set of daily aggregates for the last 14 days to validate dedupe. @nina can you grant read access to metrics_analytics:golden?

nina: granted. I'll also drop the list of sample trace_ids into RED-5110 for Pedro.

pedro: confirmed receipt. Will run the repro against the proxy canary and post results.

mike: one more ops note: if ETL stalls require partition reassignment we'll need ~30m maintenance window. I'll put an ops-runbook in RED-5111 and flag for staging rehearsal.

nina: Great. TL;DR action tracker I put in the doc:
- RED-5110 (pedro) missing spans repro + revert canary 7 Apr; revert PR 8 Apr; canary 9 Apr
- RED-5112 (alyssa) aggregate drift detector prototype 8 Apr; dedupe PR 12 Apr; canary 13 Apr
- RED-5111 (mike) ETL SLO + jitter/backoff PR 9 Apr; deploy 10 Apr; ops-runbook done 9 Apr

nina: reconvene next Mon 09:00 to review canaries. If anyone slips on dates, update the ticket and ping this thread. :eyes:
